title: Toyota Solara Convertible
description: Photograph of a 2000 Toyota Solara Convertible. Built from 1999 to 2003, the first generation toyota solara was designed from the camry to be a sporty-coupe variant to appeal to enthusiasts. With a 3.0 liter v6 making 200hp, this vehicle was a sensible option for those wanting a fun alternative to the standard camry. The convertible version arrived the next year (2000), bringing the ability to cruise around in open air. This particular solara was midified with a lowered suspension for better handling.
